title: SIB validity and need to (re)-acquire SIB

entities.name: System Information Block
entities.description: A System Information Block containing system information broadcast by the network to UEs.

entities.name: SIB Validity
entities.description: Condition determining whether a stored SIB remains valid or needs to be re-acquired.

entities.name: SIB Re-acquisition
entities.description: Procedure where the UE acquires a SIB again when the stored version is no longer valid.

relations.description: SIB re-acquisition procedure is triggered when SIB validity condition indicates the stored SIB is no longer valid.
SIB validity condition determines whether a specific SIB needs to be re-acquired.
